scripts.build: npm run api:build && npm run backoffice:build
scripts.start: npm run api:start --workspace=apps/api & npm run start --workspace=apps/backoffice
scripts.dev: npm run api:dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run start --workspace=apps/backoffice
scripts.test: npm run api:test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/backoffice
scripts.lint: npm run api:lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run backoffice:lint --workspace=apps/backoffice
